files.purpose: Domain-scoped before/after history image capture, undo/redo commits, history pointer/hash tracking, WorldState v2 serialization, and Prompt 09 save migration.
Targeted checkpoint tests for before-image scope, undo/redo content hashes, history pointer continuity, v2 persistence filtering, and Prompt 09 migration safety.

10-107.evidence: Before-image capture is limited to affected domain modules: countries, territories, topology edges, and retired country ids.

10-108.evidence: Undo applies the stored before-image as a new committed WorldState revision and restores the prior domain content hash.

10-109.evidence: Redo applies the stored after-image as a new committed WorldState revision and restores the originally applied content hash.

10-110.evidence: History pointer truncation, undo, redo, currentRevision, and historyHash are tracked continuously without store revision mismatch.

10-111.evidence: WorldState v2 serialization contains only domain modules and hash roots; transient projection, MapLibre, worker, function, and cache fields are rejected.

10-112.evidence: Prompt 09 migration accepts legacy saves, ignores unknown/deleted country ids safely, and preserves the fallback committed WorldState v2 domain state.

verification.result: No whitespace errors; existing LF-to-CRLF working-copy warnings only.
